Development Notes

November 2026

2026-11-21

Project Confluence — Corner Modules and Adjustable Building Dimensions

Adding instanced corner modules to the four-sided building shell and testing how they respond to changes in facade dimensions and floor count.

2026-11-14

Project Confluence — Assembling a Four-Sided Building Shell

Extending a two-facade corner into a four-sided building shell, testing how different facade layouts affect its footprint, and moving the placement logic into a reusable Blueprint function.

2026-11-07

Project Confluence — Configurable Facades and Building Assembly

Extending the facade Blueprint with per-cell module selection and using reusable facade actors to assemble an adjustable building corner in Unreal Engine 5.

October 2026

2026-10-31

Project Confluence — Window Kit and Facade Assembly

Developing a parameterized Blender tool for window-module preparation, checking the generated assets in Unreal Engine 5, and extending the workflow with adjustable Blueprint facade assembly.

2026-10-24

Project Confluence — Developing the First Modular Facade Assets

Developing the first facade modules in Blender, testing them in Unreal Engine 5, and using architectural context to guide a second set of window and full-height opening variations.

2026-10-17

Project Confluence — Spline-Based Procedural Infrastructure

Exploring spline-driven infrastructure construction in Unreal Engine 5 through procedural mesh deformation, dynamic component generation, and fixed-interval instancing.

2026-10-10

Project Confluence — Technical Foundations and Coastal District Blockout

The first development phase of Project Confluence connects climate-adaptive urban design with practical UE5 experiments in parameter-driven construction, environmental materials, rendering, and district blockout.

2026-10-03

Project Kinetica — From Impact Iteration to Final Technical Art Breakdown

A brief retrospective on separating collision controls, refining material response, and presenting the frozen study through the Showcase and Breakdown.
